text:
QUOTE: `_data_stale` only permits an auto-refresh when the `data` axis is stale and the process matches its source. It is non-raising, so a failed measurement degrades to "do not refresh" and never breaks a query.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The non-raising claim is made about `_data_stale`'s auto-refresh decision, not about staleness measurement degrading to no annotation on a reply, so the item's mechanism is absent.
